cantrips.name: Fire Bolt
cantrips.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 fire damage.

cantrips.name: Eldritch Blast
cantrips.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 force damage.

cantrips.name: Mage Hand
cantrips.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. You can use your action to control the hand to manipulate objects up to 10 lbs.

cantrips.name: Minor Illusion
cantrips.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

cantrips.name: Sacred Flame
cantrips.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 radiant damage.

cantrips.name: Ray of Frost
cantrips.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range. On a hit, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

cantrips.name: Guidance
cantrips.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

cantrips.name: Prestidigitation
cantrips.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice. Create sensory effects, light or snuff flames, clean or soil items, or chill/warm food.

cantrips.name: Shocking Grasp
cantrips.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch. On a hit, target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Advantage if target wears metal armor.

cantrips.name: Toll the Dead
cantrips.description: You point at one creature within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air. The target must succeed on a Wisdom save or take 1d8 necrotic damage (1d12 if missing any HP).

cantrips.name: Vicious Mockery
cantrips.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments. If the target fails a Wisdom save, it takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

cantrips.name: Thaumaturgy
cantrips.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power. Boom your voice, flicker flames, cause tremors, or slam doors open or closed.

cantrips.name: Druidcraft
cantrips.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create tiny weather predictions, bloom flowers, snuff out campfires, or create sensory nature puffs.

cantrips.name: Thorn Whip
cantrips.description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command. On a hit, pull the creature up to 10 feet closer to you.

cantrips.name: Light
cantrips.description: You touch one object. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

cantrips.name: Chill Touch
cantrips.description: You create a ghostly skeletal hand that strikes a target within range. On a hit, the target cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

cantrips.name: Spare the Dying
cantrips.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable, halting death saving throws.

level_1.name: Magic Missile
level_1.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range without requiring an attack roll.

level_1.name: Shield
level_1.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and take no damage from magic missile.

level_1.name: Cure Wounds
level_1.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

level_1.name: Healing Word
level_1.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

level_1.name: Guiding Bolt
level_1.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature within range. On a hit, target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has advantage.

level_1.name: Thunderwave
level_1.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution save or take 2d8 thunder damage and be pushed 10 feet away.

level_1.name: Mage Armor
level_1.description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier until the spell ends.

level_1.name: Burning Hands
level_1.description: Holding your hands with thumbs touching, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 3d6 fire damage.

level_1.name: Bless
level_1.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled.

level_1.name: Bane
level_1.description: Up to three creatures must make Charisma saves. On a failure, whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw, it must subtract a d4 from the result.

level_1.name: Inflict Wounds
level_1.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature within reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.

level_1.name: Command
level_1.description: You speak a one-word command (e.g. Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt) to a creature. If it fails a Wisdom saving throw, it follows the command on its next turn.

level_1.name: Sleep
level_1.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this spell can affect in ascending order of current HP.

level_1.name: Dissonant Whispers
level_1.description: You whisper a discordant melody that only one creature can hear. On a failed Wisdom save, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must immediately use its reaction to flee.

level_1.name: Hunter's Mark
level_1.description: Choose a creature within range as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

level_1.name: Hex
level_1.description: You place a curse on a creature. You deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack, and choose one ability for it to have disadvantage on checks.

level_1.name: Faerie Fire
level_1.description: Each object and creature in a 20-foot cube is outlined in blue, green, or violet light. Any attack roll against an affected creature has advantage if the attacker can see it.

level_1.name: Entangle
level_1.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained.

level_1.name: Absorb Elements
level_1.description: Triggered when you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage. You gain resistance to the triggering damage type until the start of your next turn and infuse your next melee hit with 1d6 of that type.

level_1.name: Chromatic Orb
level_1.description: You hurl a 4-inch sphere of energy at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen elemental type.

level_1.name: Detect Magic
level_1.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you and learn its school of magic.

level_2.name: Misty Step
level_2.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

level_2.name: Scorching Ray
level_2.description: You create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within range. Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. Each ray deals 2d6 fire damage on a hit.

level_2.name: Hold Person
level_2.description: Choose a humanoid within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom save or be paralyzed for the duration. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns.

level_2.name: Invisibility
level_2.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. The spell ends early if the target attacks or casts a spell.

level_2.name: Shatter
level_2.description: A sudden loud ringing noise painfully intense erupts at a point within range in a 10-foot radius sphere. Creatures take 3d8 thunder damage (half on Con save). Inorganic targets have disadvantage.

level_2.name: Mirror Image
level_2.description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Attackers must roll randomly to see if they target a duplicate rather than you.

level_2.name: Spiritual Weapon
level_2.description: You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration. You can make a melee spell attack with it on this turn and as a bonus action on subsequent turns.

level_2.name: Moonbeam
level_2.description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the beam take 2d10 radiant damage (half on Con save).

level_2.name: Pass Without Trace
level_2.description: A veil of shadows and silence radiates from you. Each creature within 30 feet gains a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and cannot be tracked except by magical means.

level_2.name: Web
level_2.description: You conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing in a 20-foot cube. Creatures in the area must succeed on a Dex save or be restrained.

level_2.name: Lesser Restoration
level_2.description: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

level_2.name: Suggestion
level_2.description: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature that fails a Wisdom save to pursue that course.

level_3.name: Fireball
level_3.components: V, S, M (bat guano and sulfur)
level_3.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range, then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame in a 20-foot radius. Each creature takes 8d6 fire damage (half on Dex save).

level_3.name: Counterspell
level_3.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, it fails. If higher, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC 10 + spell level).

level_3.name: Lightning Bolt
level_3.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you. Each creature in the line takes 8d6 lightning damage (half on Dex save).

level_3.name: Revivify
level_3.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point.

level_3.name: Spirit Guardians
level_3.description: You call forth spirits to protect you. Flitting around you to a distance of 15 feet, an affected creature's speed is halved, and when it enters or starts its turn there, it takes 3d8 radiant or necrotic damage on a failed Wisdom save.

level_3.name: Haste
level_3.description: Choose a willing creature within range. Its speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, advantage on Dex saves, and gains an additional action each turn.

level_3.name: Fly
level_3.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration.

level_3.name: Dispel Magic
level_3.description: Choose one creature, object, or magical effect within range. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends. For higher spells, make an ability check (DC 10 + spell level).

level_3.name: Hypnotic Pattern
level_3.description: You create a twisting pattern of colors in a 30-foot cube. Each creature that sees the pattern must make a Wisdom save or become charmed and incapacitated.

level_3.name: Call Lightning
level_3.description: A storm cloud appears. When you cast the spell and as an action on later turns, you can call down a bolt of lightning dealing 3d10 lightning damage (half on Dex save).

level_4.name: Polymorph
level_4.description: This spell transforms a creature into a beast whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's level. The target assumes the beast's hit points and game statistics.

level_4.name: Greater Invisibility
level_4.description: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible for up to 1 minute, persisting even through attacks and spellcasting.

level_4.name: Dimension Door
level_4.description: You teleport yourself to any place within range that you can visualize or describe. You can bring along one willing creature of your size or smaller.

level_4.name: Banishment
level_4.description: You attempt to send one creature to another plane of existence. On a failed Charisma save, native creatures are sent to a demiplane; extraplanar creatures are returned home.

level_4.name: Wall of Fire
level_4.description: You create a wall of fire on a solid surface. Creatures ending their turn within 10 feet of the hot side take 5d8 fire damage on a failed Dex save.

level_4.name: Blight
level_4.description: Necromantic energy washes over a creature within range, draining moisture and vitality. Target takes 8d8 necrotic damage (half on Con save).

level_5.name: Wall of Force
level_5.description: An invisible, indestructible barrier of force springs into existence. It cannot be dispelled by dispel magic and extends into the Ethereal Plane.

level_5.name: Cone of Cold
level_5.description: A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone takes 8d8 cold damage on a failed Con save (half on success).

level_5.name: Hold Monster
level_5.description: Choose a creature within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom save or be paralyzed for the duration, regardless of creature type.

level_5.name: Greater Restoration
level_5.description: You touch a creature and end one effect reducing its ability scores, max HP, or end charmed/petrified/exhaustion levels.

level_5.name: Mass Cure Wounds
level_5.description: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point within range. Up to six creatures in a 30-foot radius regain 3d8 + spellcasting modifier HP.

level_6.name: Heal
level_6.description: A surge of positive energy washes through a creature, restoring 70 hit points and ending blindness, deafness, and any diseases.

level_6.name: Chain Lightning
level_6.components: V, S, M (fur and glass amber)
level_6.description: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target and jumps to up to three other targets within 30 feet, dealing 10d8 lightning damage each.

level_6.name: Disintegrate
level_6.description: A thin green ray springs from your finger. A target takes 10d6+40 force damage on a failed Dex save. If this reduces it to 0 HP, it is turned to fine grey dust.

level_6.name: Sunbeam
level_6.description: A beam of brilliant sunlight flashes out in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line. Creatures take 6d8 radiant damage and are blinded on a failed Con save.

level_7.name: Teleport
level_7.description: Instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures to a known destination anywhere on the same plane of existence.

level_7.name: Finger of Death
level_7.description: You send negative energy coursing through a creature. Takes 7d8+30 necrotic damage on a failed Con save. A humanoid killed by this rises as a permanent zombie under your command.

level_7.name: Forcecage
level_7.description: An immobile, invisible, cube-shaped prison of force springs into existence, trapping creatures inside without a saving throw.

level_7.name: Resurrection
level_7.description: You touch a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century. It returns to life with all its hit points.

level_8.name: Dominate Monster
level_8.description: You attempt to beguile a creature. On a failed Wisdom save, it is charmed by you and follows your telepathic commands completely.

level_8.name: Sunburst
level_8.description: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot radius sphere. Creatures take 12d6 radiant damage and are blinded for 1 minute on a failed Con save.

level_9.name: Wish
level_9.description: The mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality or duplicate any 8th-level spell or lower.

level_9.name: Meteor Swarm
level_9.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four points within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere takes 40d6 total damage (half on Dex save).

level_9.name: Power Word Kill
level_9.description: You utter a word of power that compels one creature you can see within range to die instantly if it has 100 hit points or fewer.

level_9.name: Time Stop
level_9.description: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself. No other creature can move or act during the 1d4+1 turns you take in a row.

level_9.name: Mass Heal
level_9.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you. You restore up to 700 hit points divided as you choose among any number of creatures within range.
